title: reader/credentials: dummy hash uses global DEFAULT_COST timing oracle
description: CredentialStore::check() in crates/reader/src/store/credentials.rs uses a global OnceLock<String> DUMMY_HASH at bcrypt::DEFAULT_COST. When production credentials are stored at a different cost factor, the timing for unknown-username lookups differs from known-username lookups, leaking the username set via timing oracle. The auth crate (crates/auth/src/store.rs) had this exact bug and was fixed last session with a per-instance dummy_hash field computed via parse_bcrypt_cost/make_dummy_hash. Apply the same fix to the reader's CredentialStore.
